scenes.heading: Choosing a coaching niche and defining who you actually help

sents.d: Choosing a coaching niche and defining who you actually help
A specific niche makes marketing and referrals far easier than a general one.

scenes.heading: Vague titles are hard to refer

sents.d: 'Life coach' or 'business consultant' without further definition is hard to market and hard to refer, since potential clients and referral sources can't easily picture who specifically you help and with what.

scenes.heading: Who you help, and what outcome

sents.d: A useful niche definition combines who you help (a specific type of person or business) with what specific outcome you help them reach — 'helping first-time managers navigate their first year in a leadership role' is far more referable than 'leadership coaching.'

Niching down doesn't have to be permanent — many coaches and consultants narrow further or shift focus over time as they learn more about who they enjoy working with and where they get the strongest results.

take: Define exactly who you help and the outcome you deliver.
